# Library Lending: communication history

Version 0.1.0 of the specification: 4 communications, 1 session and 1 test session are recorded beside it, in `records/communications/`, `records/sessions/` and `records/test-sessions/`. They come first in time order, then the history of each stakeholder and of each question, decision and element they touch. Each record says who said what to whom, when, by which channel and whether the words are verbatim or a summary; 3 communications carry no evidence and read as what their recorder wrote down. People are named by role.

## 1. In time order

In, said by the stakeholder to the project: from member to librarian, by call, at 2026-10-09T10:15:00Z. Recorded by librarian.

In summary: A member who cannot reach the library by the due date asked to keep the book a little longer without paying the late fee.

Recorded without evidence: the record holds what librarian wrote down and nothing that shows it.

In, said by the stakeholder to the project: from library-board to librarian, by email, at 2026-10-10T14:30:00Z, part of the source desk-interview. Recorded by librarian.

Verbatim: “A member may renew a loan once, for the same period, when no other member has reserved the copy. A second renewal is refused.” Person: the board secretary.

### SES-1: session “Renewals with the desk, the board and a member” (meeting)

From 2026-10-13T15:00:00Z to 2026-10-13T16:00:00Z. Invited: librarian, library-board, member, library-it. Present: librarian, library-board, member. Absent: library-it. Recorded by librarian.

### TS-1: test session “Acceptance of the renewal and the fee cap” (uat on production, version 0.2.0)

From 2026-10-21T10:00:00Z to 2026-10-21T11:30:00Z, build library-lending 0.2.0 at 7c1e4a9. Invited: librarian, library-board, library-it. Present: librarian, library-it. Absent: library-board. Result: passed. Recorded by librarian.

A loan was renewed once and a second renewal refused; a late return of a lost book was charged the replacement cost and no more. The desk objected to where the Renew action sits (COM-4).

Said in it: COM-4.

Recorded without evidence: the record holds what librarian wrote down and nothing that shows it.

Touches: elements LIB-4, LIB-5; changes CR-1; defects DEF-1.
